grade: modelled (exact calendar arithmetic on the S81-BALANCE stage model of record; measured by MU.TOK)

pos.rule: pos of user k at pass p = pos0_k + p * stride; AR stride 1, MTP stride 6 verify positions a step (accepted count varies, the calendar does not)

bases.units: HBM sectors (32 B) relative to the group copy region base
bases.note: modelled default (svc_att header); replaced by svc_bases.json when lane MU-S81/SVC commits it

premise.rule: every non-replicated window <= slot spacing; every duplicated window <= per-copy spacing

latency_user.note: user 0 runs the single-user schedule unshifted on copy A: its windows are the single-user windows, and no other user touches them (brute_force) -> its rate and cycle trace are the single-user ones

circuits.rule: S81-LINK5 (owner 10-21 06:00): 5 static circuits a stage die, stage hop on its own s_0N circuit (1 crossing), d+2 TP on one EN<->EN circuit

per_die.peer: stage k, rank r-1, s_7S pair A
stage k, rank r+1, s_0S pair A
stage k, rank r+2, s_7N pair A
per_die.use: TP d+2 (ONE bidirectional circuit EN<->EN; d+2 parts land on s_7N RX) + host plane (open, see README)

per_die.peer: stage k+1, rank r, s_0N pair B
per_die.use: stage NEXT: h TX, every window ab 0; RX = link layer only

per_die.peer: stage k-1, rank r, s_0N pair A
per_die.use: stage PREV: h RX -> ri; TX = link layer only
reserved: copy-B static circuit of the pre/post-group rank dies of the 8 duplicated groups

lanes.note: 8 copy-A SerDes (4 endpoints x pair A) + 2 pair-B SerDes on s_0N

circuits.hop_port: s_0N pair A TX -> successor s_0N pair B RX
circuits.ab_rule: every stage-hop TX window opens with ab 0 (pair A); no ab 1 window on any s_0N endpoint -> s_0N pair A RX carries link layer only -> no pair-A / pair-B co-release into ri (sticky fault) by construction

tx_delay_fix.note: alternative to land 1: hold the h TX on the sender until n is free (each of these groups' stage start moves by its deficit; upper bound on the added period); or a landing leaf with NS >= 4 (one whole 320-beat h)

hop_windows.result: FAULT (land 1 with NS 1 cannot hold 4 back-to-back windows)
hop_windows.rule: land 0 iff spacing(n) - occ(n) >= hop - crossing; the 4 windows of one h are one user's, back to back on s_0N pair A (non-h beat inside a window / overlapping windows = lep sticky fault)

circuits.tp_ports: s_0S / s_7S / s_7N carry TP only (no h window): their lep ports are held by the stage-group window (brute force on <g>.<cp>)

config.helper_window_source: results/arch/s81_l20_1019/split/split.json mu_helper_windows: split.json rank_tree.6.helper_occupancy_max (+ reader time for the MU shard: 52429 keys a die vs 43691); MTP = one shared key read + 6 x (select + merge) -- the B3 shared read the record MU calendar assumes for S029 itself

check.note: own_offset: the compiler places the helper stage's own svc/HBM window (Lo) at an offset inside its stage window; PASS needs one feasible offset (first_feasible), any = every offset is free
